+"""Run the MySQL unsupported-plugin password-expiration MTR regression."""
+
+from pathlib import Path as _AC_Path
+_AC_CHECKS_DIR = _AC_Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+SCENARIO_PATH = Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR / 'scenario.json'))
+CHECK_DIR = Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR))
+SOURCE_ROOT = Path("/src")
+TEST_NAME = "auth_expire_unsupported_plugin"
+TEST_PATH = Path("mysql-test/t") / f"{TEST_NAME}.test"
+RESULT_PATH = Path("mysql-test/r") / f"{TEST_NAME}.result"
+
+
+def emit(scenario, *, checks=None, reproduced=False, error=None, transcript=None):
+    result = {
+        "origin": scenario.get("origin"),
+        "checks": checks or [],
+        "reproduced": bool(reproduced),
+        "transcript": transcript or [],
+    }
+    if error:
+        result["harness_error"] = error
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    scenario = json.loads(SCENARIO_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    test_source = CHECK_DIR / scenario["test_file"]
+    result_source = CHECK_DIR / scenario["result_file"]
+    mtr = SOURCE_ROOT / "mysql-test" / "mysql-test-run.pl"
+    if not mtr.is_file():
+        emit(scenario, error="MYSQL_MTR_NOT_FOUND")
+        return 0
+    if not test_source.is_file() or not result_source.is_file():
+        emit(scenario, error="MYSQL_MTR_ASSET_NOT_FOUND")
+        return 0
+
+    test_dest = SOURCE_ROOT / TEST_PATH
+    result_dest = SOURCE_ROOT / RESULT_PATH
+    test_dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    result_dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copyfile(test_source, test_dest)
+    shutil.copyfile(result_source, result_dest)
+
+    vardir = Path("/tmp/acrepair-mtr-f76a8b60b699")
+    shutil.rmtree(vardir, ignore_errors=True)
+    argv = ["perl", str(mtr), "--vardir=" + str(vardir), TEST_NAME]
+    try:
+        completed = subprocess.run(
+            argv,
+            cwd=str(mtr.parent),
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            timeout=int(scenario.get("query_timeout_seconds", 300)),
+        )
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        emit(
+            scenario,
+            error="MYSQL_MTR_TIMEOUT",
+            transcript=[{"command": argv, "stdout": exc.stdout or "", "stderr": exc.stderr or ""}],
+        )
+        return 0
+    except OSError as exc:
+        emit(scenario, error="MYSQL_MTR_EXECUTION_FAILED: " + str(exc))
+        return 0
+
+    log_text = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
+    transcript = [{
+        "command": argv,
+        "returncode": completed.returncode,
+        "stdout": completed.stdout,
+        "stderr": completed.stderr,
+    }]
+    status = re.search(
+        rf"\b{re.escape(TEST_NAME)}\b.*\[\s*(pass|fail)\s*\]",
+        log_text,
+        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
+    )
+    if not status:
+        emit(scenario, error="MYSQL_MTR_DID_NOT_REPORT_TEST_STATUS", transcript=transcript)
+        return 0
+
+    passed = status.group(1).lower() == "pass"
+    check = {
+        "name": "unsupported_auth_plugin_password_expiry_is_rejected",
+        "kind": "target",
+        "passed": completed.returncode == 0 and passed,
+        "actual": {"mtr_returncode": completed.returncode, "mtr_log": log_text},
+        "expected": {"mtr_returncode": 0, "output": scenario["expected_output"]},
+    }
+    reject = vardir / "log" / f"{TEST_NAME}.reject"
+    reproduced = False
+    if reject.is_file():
+        reject_text = reject.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        transcript.append({"reject_file": str(reject), "text": reject_text})
+        reproduced = scenario["bug_output_marker"] in reject_text
+    if completed.returncode != 0 and not reproduced:
+        emit(scenario, error="MYSQL_MTR_FAILED_WITHOUT_EXPIRY_MARKER", transcript=transcript)
+        return 0
+    emit(scenario, checks=[check], reproduced=reproduced, transcript=transcript)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
